DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの点をご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この説明を家で読み、余白に質問を書きました。書き込みが多くなったので、先に二つにまとめて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 多い書込みを二つの質問にまとめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I read this explanation at home and wrote questions in the margins. There are now a lot of notes, so I'd like to organize them into two questions before asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to organize your many notes into two questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは、今の住所で対象になるかです。もう一つは、対象なら何を用意するかです。書類名だけ先に聞くと混乱しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象確認と必要書類の質問を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is whether I'm eligible at my current address. The other is what I need to prepare if I am. I think I'd get confused if I asked only for document names first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between asking about eligibility and the required documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず対象の確認から担当へつなぎます。お住まいの状況を説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll connect you with the staff to check eligibility first. Can you explain your living situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。市内へ引っ越したばかりです。説明の対象者の欄を示し、私の場合が含まれるか尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引越し状況を説明して対象者欄を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I've just moved into the city. I'd like to point to the section on eligible people and ask whether my situation is included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your move and point to the eligible-person section in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き込んだほかの質問も、同じ内容でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are the other questions you've written about the same thing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「引っ越した人もよいか」と「今の住所でよいか」は同じ質問でした。この二つを対象の確認にまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重複した質問を一つにまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: 'Are people who have moved here allowed?' and 'Is my current address acceptable?' were the same question. I'll combine those as a question about eligibility.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Combine the duplicate questions into one in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な物については、対象の説明を受けてからですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You'll ask what you need after hearing the explanation about eligibility, then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。対象かを確認してから、用意する物を聞きます。回答は質問の横に書き、解決した項目に印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 質問の順番と回答の記録方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check whether I'm eligible before asking what to prepare. I'll write the answers beside the questions and mark the items that have been resolved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the order of your questions and how you will record the answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。説明の紙をお持ちのまま、担当へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep the explanation sheet with you and go to the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次のご案内の前に、何かございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything before I direct you to the next place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受付の時に上着をこちらへ置きました。次の場所へ行く前に持っていきたいのですが、どこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 移動前に置いた上着の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my jacket here when I checked in. I'd like to take it with me before going to the next place. Where is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where the jacket you left is before moving on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような上着でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does the jacket look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紺色で、胸に小さい白い模様があります。さっき書類を書く時に脱いで、椅子の背へ掛けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上着の特徴と置いた状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's navy blue, with a small white design on the chest. I took it off when filling in the documents a little while ago and hung it on the chair back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the jacket's features and how you left it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の横の椅子でしょうか。こちらで場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The chair beside reception? I'll check where it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。その椅子です。似た上着を勝手に持たず、模様と内側のタグも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 似た品と区別する確認方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, that chair. Rather than taking a similar jacket without permission, I'd like to check the design and the tag inside too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese how you will distinguish it from a similar item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この上着をご確認ください。ポケットに入れた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check this jacket. Is there anything in the pockets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の上着です。ポケットにはハンカチが一枚あります。診察券は別に持っているので、上着の中を探す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の品とポケットの中身を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's my jacket. There's one handkerchief in the pocket. I have my patient card separately, so there's no need to search the jacket for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that it is yours and what is in the pocket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、お持ちになって次の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then take it with you and wait for the next directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。上着は手元にまとめました。椅子にほかの荷物が残っていないことも確認してから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着をまとめて忘れ物を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I've gathered my jacket with my belongings. I'll also check that no other luggage is left on the chair before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have your jacket and will check for forgotten belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらへご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋を片方なくしました。残った方を持ってきたので、特徴を説明する時に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片方の手袋をなくし残りを見本にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've lost one glove. I brought the remaining one, so could you look at it while I explain its features?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you lost one glove and want to use the other as a sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左右のどちらをなくしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you lose the right or left one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右手の方です。こちらにあるのは左手です。左右一組がなくなったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紛失した左右と手元の左右を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The right-hand one. This one is the left. I haven't lost the whole pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the side you lost from the side you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色と模様は両方同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are the color and design the same on both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ灰色で、手首に白い線があります。ただ、残った方を裏返して持っていたので、表の模様を見せ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と模様を表側で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They're the same gray, with a white line at the wrist. But I was holding this one inside out, so I'll turn it back to show the outside design.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the color and design on the outside in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に両方あったのはいつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: When did you last have both?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝、外へ出る時です。歩いている途中で外してポケットに入れ、片方がないと気付いたのは駅の前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最後の確認と紛失に気付くまでの経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This morning when I went outside. I took them off while walking and put them in my pocket, and noticed one was missing in front of the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese when you last checked them and what happened before you noticed the loss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残った方は、ご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the remaining glove yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この左手の方は預ける紛失品ではなく、特徴の見本として見せました。右手だけ探していることと気付いた場所をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本は手元へ残し探す品を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I showed this left-hand one as a sample of its features, not as lost property to leave here. I'll tell you I'm looking only for the right one and where I noticed it missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the sample and identify the item you are looking for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。片方の紛失として、経緯と特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll ask about the circumstances and features as the loss of one glove.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What can I help you with regarding mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 返信用封筒を渡されました。宛先は印刷されていますが、自分の住所を書く場所と、中へ入れる物を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信用封筒の住所欄と中身を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was given a reply envelope. The destination address is printed, but I'd like to check where to write my own address and what to put inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check the address field and contents of a reply envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒と、同封の案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the envelope and the enclosed instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。案内には記入した紙を返送とあります。案内そのものも送り返す必要があるか、書いた人へ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内の返送指定で未確認の点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The instructions say to return the completed sheet. I haven't checked with the person who wrote them whether the instruction sheet itself also needs to be sent back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese what remains unchecked about the return instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身の指定は差出先へ確認する内容です。封筒の表裏はご一緒に見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: What to enclose is something to check with the recipient. We can look at the front and back of the envelope together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。表の印刷された住所を書き消さず、裏の差出人の欄に自分の住所を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛先を残して差出人欄へ住所を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll leave the printed destination address on the front intact and write my own address in the sender field on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the destination address and write your address in the sender field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封をする前に、返す紙が揃っているかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before sealing it, check that all the papers to be returned are there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内の紙まで入れるかは差出先に聞きます。返送する紙に記入漏れがないかも確認して、今日はまだ閉じません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封を保留して返送物と記入漏れを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the recipient whether to include the instruction sheet too. I'll also check the return papers for missing entries and won't seal it today yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave it unsealed and check what to return and any missing entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済みましたら、大きさや重さに合う方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've checked, we can explain a mailing method appropriate to the size and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の住所だけ記入し、返す物の指定を確かめてから封をします。宛先の印刷はそのまま使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 準備から封入までの順序を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll just fill in my own address, check the requirements for what to return, and then seal it. I'll use the printed destination address as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the sequence from preparation to sealing the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご準備ができましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What can I help you with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 振込みの控えを受け取りました。今月は支払いが三つあるので、この控えがどの支払いか分かるように保管したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 複数の支払いから控えを識別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've received my bank-transfer receipt. I have three payments this month, so I'd like to store it so I can tell which payment it relates to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to identify which of several payments the receipt is for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えにある振込先と金額は、ご自身の予定と合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do the recipient and amount on the receipt match what you intended?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。これは家賃の振込みです。ほかの二つはまだ払っていないので、三つとも支払済みにしないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 振込済みの家賃と未払い二件を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. This is the rent transfer. I haven't paid the other two yet, so I want to make sure I don't mark all three as paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between the paid rent and the two unpaid items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家計の記録と控えを照らして保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Store the receipt by matching it with your household accounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メモの家賃の行だけに済みの印を付けます。控えにある日付と金額を、その行に写しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家計メモに支払済み情報を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll mark only the rent row in my note as paid. I'll copy the date and amount on the receipt into that row.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the paid information in your household note in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控え自体に書き込む予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you plan to write on the receipt itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 印字を隠したくないので、控えはそのままにします。入れる袋へ自分の管理番号を書き、家計メモにも同じ番号を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えを改変せず袋とメモに管理番号を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't want to cover the print, so I'll leave the receipt unchanged. I'll write my own filing number on the bag I put it in and put the same number in my household note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not alter the receipt but will number the bag and note for your own filing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その番号は銀行の受付番号とは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That number is separate from the bank's reference number, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私の整理用の番号です。問い合わせる時は、それだけでなく控えの内容を示します。残りの二つは未払いの欄に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 私用番号と銀行の情報を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. It's my own organizing number. If I inquire, I'll show the receipt's details as well, not just that number. I'll leave the other two in the unpaid section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese your own number from the bank information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。控えを大切に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep the receipt safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来客に出す果物を選んでいます。家の器が浅いので、大きな房をそのまま置くより、小分けにできる物がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 浅い器に小分けで盛れる果物を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm choosing fruit to serve guests. My dishes at home are shallow, so I want something I can divide into smaller portions rather than put a large bunch on them whole.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for fruit you can serve in small portions in shallow dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何人でお召し上がりになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many people will be eating?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四人です。一人ずつ小さい器に入れたいので、房の見た目より、分けて盛れる量を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数と盛付け量の考え方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Four. I'd like to put it into a small dish for each person, so I want to consider how much I can divide and serve rather than the appearance of the bunch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the number of people and how you are thinking about serving portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの二種類を比べられます。皮などの扱いも違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare these two kinds. How you handle the peel and so on is different too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この品は家で皮をむいて切る必要がありますね。来客前に準備する時間があるので、四人分に分けられるか量を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 選ぶ品の下準備と準備時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one needs to be peeled and cut at home, right? I have time to prepare before the guests arrive, so I'll consider whether the amount divides into four servings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check in Japanese the preparation required for your choice and the time available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 器の大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the size of the dishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 直径が十センチほどです。買う果物を全部無理に盛らず、食べる分を器へ入れ、残りは商品の表示に沿って保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 器の大きさと盛る分と残す分を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: About ten centimeters across. I won't force all the fruit I buy into them. I'll serve the amount we'll eat and store the rest according to the product label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese the dish size and distinguish what you will serve from what you will keep.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの小さい袋もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is also this small bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その袋にします。四人へ同じくらいずつ分け、器がいっぱいなら盛り足さず、残りを後で出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小袋を選び盛付け方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take that bag. I'll divide it about equally among four people. If the dishes are full, I won't add more; I'll serve the remainder later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the small bag and decide how to serve it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。こちらの商品をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内のご案内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can I help you find your way around the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と来ています。私は写真でよく止まりますが、友人は歩きたいので、互いに待つ時間を減らす過ごし方を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真と散歩で同行者の過ごし方が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here with a friend. I stop often for photos, but my friend wants to walk, so we're thinking of a way to spend our time that reduces how long we wait for each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you and your companion prefer different activities: photography and walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お友達は、もう先へ進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has your friend already gone ahead?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ隣にいます。黙って別行動にせず、まずここで希望を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別行動の前に希望を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, they're still beside me. Instead of silently going off separately, I'll ask what they want here first and decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check your companion's wishes before doing things separately in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図を一緒に見ることはできますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can look at the map together, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人は池まで歩きたいそうです。私はここで一枚だけ撮って、一緒に池へ向かうことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影枚数を区切り共通の目的地を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My friend says they want to walk to the pond. I'll take just one picture here and then we'll head to the pond together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Set a limit on photos and decide a shared destination in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中でも何枚も撮る予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you planning to take many more photos on the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中では撮らず、池で休む時に撮ります。友人を毎回立たせて待たせるより、二人が止まる時に合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の休憩に撮影を合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't take any on the way; I'll take them when we rest at the pond. Rather than making my friend stand and wait each time, I'll match the time when we both stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will fit photography around your companion's rest break.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 池から先は、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: What will you do after the pond?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休んでから二人で決めます。私の写真が終わっただけで友人も帰りたいとは考えず、次の希望を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後の行動を二人で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll decide together after resting. I won't assume my friend wants to go home just because I'm done with my photos; I'll ask what they want to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese how you will decide together what to do after resting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お二人で園内をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Both of you enjoy the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に切符を渡そうとしたら、二枚の行先が違いました。今日の分と別の日の分を混ぜたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の切符の行先が異なると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I tried to give my friend a ticket, I noticed the two tickets had different destinations. It seems I've mixed today's ticket with one for another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about two tickets with different destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日向かう駅はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which station are you heading to today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人と海辺の駅へ行きます。こちらの一枚は山側の駅で、来週一人で行く予定の分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日と来週の予定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm going to the seaside station with my friend. This other ticket is for the station in the mountains, where I plan to go alone next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between today's and next week's plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二枚とも今日の二人分ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the two tickets aren't both for the two of you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。二枚あるから二人分は揃ったと思い込んでいました。海辺の駅へ行く切符を、もう一人分用意したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枚数と今日の人数を混同したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's right. I'd assumed that having two tickets meant we had enough for two people. I'd like to get one more ticket for the seaside station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you confused the number of tickets with the number of people traveling today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入前に、今日使える切符かもそれぞれ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before buying, let's check each ticket to see whether it can be used today too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。友人へ渡す前に行先と使用できる日を確かめ、来週の分は別のポケットへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使用日と行先を確認して券を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll check the destination and valid date before handing one to my friend, and put next week's ticket in another pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the date and destination and separate the tickets in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の二人分は同じ区間ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are both of today's tickets for the same section of travel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、同じ区間です。今日の分が二枚揃ったら二人で確認し、一枚ずつ持ちます。来週の券は今日使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同一区間二人分を揃えて各自持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the same section. Once we have two tickets for today, we'll check them together and each carry one. I won't use next week's ticket today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will get two tickets for the same section and each carry one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の切符の確認からお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll help by checking today's ticket first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入でお困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you need help filling in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連絡先の欄があります。家の電話と携帯のどちらを書くか迷っています。昼間は家にいないことが多いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日中不在のため記入する電話を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a contact field. I'm unsure whether to write my home phone or mobile number. I'm often not at home during the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which phone number to enter because you are away during the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの欄の説明には、日中連絡が取れる番号とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The instructions for this field say a number where you can be reached during the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら携帯を書きたいです。ただ、仕事中は出られない時間があります。そのことも伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯を選び応答できない時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like to write my mobile number. But there are times when I can't answer at work. Can I tell you that too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose your mobile number and explain in Japanese the times you cannot answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時間の希望をどこに記すか、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the staff where to note your preferred times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。番号を二つ書いてどちらでもよいとするより、まず携帯を連絡先にし、出られない時間を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 主な番号と時間の希望を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than write two numbers and say either is okay, I'd like to make my mobile the contact number first and explain when I can't answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your main number separately from your preferred contact times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の携帯番号は今確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you check your own mobile number now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この画面で確認して写します。家族の携帯の番号と混ざらないよう、最後の数字まで見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の番号を確認して正確に写す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll check it on this screen and copy it. I'll compare it right to the last digit so I don't mix it up with a family member's mobile number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check and accurately copy your own number in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡できない時間については、どうお伝えになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: How will you explain the times you cannot be reached?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 平日の午前中は出られません。午後なら確認できます。必ず即答できるとは言わず、希望の時間として担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 応答の希望時間を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can't answer on weekday mornings. I can check in the afternoons. I won't say I can always reply immediately; I'll tell the staff those are my preferred times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give specific preferred times for answering in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。記入場所と時間のご希望を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check with the staff where to write it and about your preferred times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待合の席が混んでいます。近くの別の場所で待ちたいのですが、呼ばれた時に見付からなくならないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待つ場所を変える前に呼出しを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The waiting-room seats are crowded. I'd like to wait somewhere else nearby, but I want to check that you won't be unable to find me when I'm called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the calling procedure before changing where you wait in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらでお待ちになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where would you like to wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付から見えるあの椅子です。病院の外へ出たいのではなく、ここで呼出しが聞こえるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望位置と外出ではないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: That chair you can see from reception. I don't want to go outside the hospital; I want to check whether I can hear the call there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese where you want to wait and that you are not going outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの待合の椅子ですので、ご利用いただけます。呼出しが聞き取れなければ受付へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is one of our waiting-room chairs, so you can use it. If you can't make out the call, please check with reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。場所を変える前にお伝えできてよかったです。荷物は元の席に残さず、全部持って移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動前に知らせ荷物を全て持つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'm glad I could tell you before changing places. I'll take all my belongings with me rather than leave them on the original seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell reception before moving and say in Japanese that you will take all your belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご一緒の方はいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人です。私の名前を呼ぶ時、あの椅子にいることが分かるよう、予約票も確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人で待つことと名前の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm alone. Could you also check my appointment slip so you know I'll be on that chair when you call my name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are waiting alone and ask them to check your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お名前を確認しました。こちらの予約票はお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've checked your name. Please keep this appointment slip with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。票と荷物を持ってあの椅子へ移ります。さらに別の場所へ動く必要があれば、先に受付へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定場所へ移り次の移動も知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll take the slip and my belongings to that chair. If I need to move somewhere else again, I'll tell reception first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move to the specified place and report any further move too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。あちらでお待ちください。
